﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: google-cloud-pubsublite 0.6.0 -> 1.6.3

## Context

Project `java-pubsub-group-kafka-connector` (by googleapis) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.google.cloud:google-cloud-pubsublite` from `0.6.0` to `1.6.3` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/googleapis/java-pubsub-group-kafka-connector/pull/41

## Your Task

The source code is in `/java-pubsub-group-kafka-connector`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll start by understanding the project structure and the compilation errors.

arguments.description: Run Maven compile to see compilation errors

    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/maven-v4_0_0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <groupId>com.google.pubsub.kafka.connect</groupId>

  <url>http://maven.apache.org</url>
  <properties>
    <maven.compiler.source>1.8</maven.compiler.source>
    <maven.compiler.target>1.8</maven.compiler.target>
  </properties>

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>junit</groupId>

      <version>2.18.7</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>

      <version>1.10.0</version>

          </configuration>

          <filters>

            <phase>package</phase>

        <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
        <configuration>
          <source>8</source>
          <target>8</target>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.xolstice.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>protobuf-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>0.6.1</version>

          <pluginArtifact>
            io.grpc:protoc-gen-grpc-java:1.16.1:exe:${os.detected.classifier}
          </pluginArtifact>
          <protoSourceRoot>${project.basedir}/src/main/proto</protoSourceRoot>
        </configuration>
        <executions>
          <execution>
            <goals>
              <goal>compile</goal>
              <goal>compile-custom</goal>
            </goals>
          </execution>
        </executions>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>
